data.title: Serial killer Aem Cyanide gets fourth death sentence
data.description: The Criminal Court on Tuesday sentenced Sararat Rangsiwuthaporn, aka Aem Cyanide, 39, to death for fatally poisoning her creditor in Phetchaburi province in August 2022.

data.title: Gen Z brings Thai heritage into fashion and daily life
data.description: From floral hair garlands to lotus photo shoots and Khon shows, young Thais are renewing cultural traditions and bringing activity to local businesses.

data.title: Macron holds ‘constructive’ talks with Trump
data.description: NEW YORK - French President Emmanuel Macron said he had “very constructive” talks with his US counterpart Donald Trump on the conflicts in the Middle East and Ukraine.

data.title: Missing F-35 fighter parts 'not sensitive', says Australia minister
data.description: SYDNEY — Missing F-35 fighter parts diverted from Australia to Hong Kong are not "sensitive", Defence Minister Richard Marles said Tuesday, confirming Canberra was helping to investigate the incident.

data.title: Thailand says teams careful of doping rules after badminton player fails drug test
data.description: NAGOYA - Sports and Tourism Minister Surasak Phancharoenworakul ​said the nation's athletes at the Asian Games ​are all aware and ‌careful of doping rules following a failed drug test by one of the country's top badminton players.

data.title: Afghan cyclist who disguised herself as man wins Asian Games silver
data.description: NAGOYA — An Afghan cyclist who disguised herself as a man to pursue her sporting dreams won an Asian Games silver medal on Tuesday, hoping it inspires other women in a country where Taliban authorities have sharply curtailed their freedoms.

data.title: 7.6m speed pills hidden in generator seized in Nakhon Sawan
data.description: Highway police in Nakhon Sawan province have seized 7.6 million speed pills hidden inside a generator and arrested four suspected members of a drug smuggling gang.

data.title: ONE Championship: Freddie Haggerty targets Sam-A as he plots strawweight title route
data.description: Freddie Haggerty has set his sights on Thailand’s Sam-A Gaiyanghadao as he plots a route towards ONE Championship’s strawweight Muay Thai title – and says friendship would not stop him facing fellow Englishman Ellis Barboza.

data.title: City Hall pledges quick reopening of two children's museums
data.description: The Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA) has promised to quickly find a new team to operate and reopen two childen's museums being forced to close next week by financial red tape.

data.title: Cambodia showcases scams crackdown with global conference
data.description: PHNOM PENH - Cambodia showed off a shuttered scam compound complete with counterfeit cash and a fake police station this week ahead of a global conference intended to burnish its anti-fraud credentials.

data.title: Six-year-old Chinese girl sets world record with Rubik's Cube
data.description: BEIJING - A six-year-old Chinese girl has set a new women's world record for solving a 3x3 Rubik's Cube in just over four seconds, state media reported.

data.title: Huawei, SVOA and ACONNECT Join Forces to Advance AI-Powered Customer Service
data.description: Bangkok, 21 September 2026 – Huawei, SVOA Public Company Limited (SVOA), and “Aconnect Contact Center”, a business of Advanced Research Group (ARG) signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) on Artificial Intelligence Contact Center (AICC) solutions, marking a new step in their collaboration to develop AI-powered customer service solutions for organisations in Thailand. The collaboration aims to enhance Contact Center efficiency and elevate customer experience, with an initial focus on banking, insurance, retail, and large enterprises.

data.title: Thais dispute repeated Cambodian cultural claims in 2026
data.description: Miss Universe Cambodia 2026 renews Thai criticism over cultural claims, following disputes involving traditional dress, Khon, Muay Thai and Songkran.

data.title: Chakriwat seeks return to Thailand for life-saving surgery
data.description: Chakriwat Vivacharawongse, an estranged son of His Majesty the King, has appealed for help to return to Thailand from Malaysia for medical treatment, saying his health has deteriorated significantly.

data.title: Star coaches make their bows as Nations League returns
data.description: PARIS - The 2026/27 Nations League kicks off on Thursday but all eyes will be on the touchlines as a starry cast of new coaches, including Zinedine Zidane and Jurgen Klopp, prepare to make their debuts in international football.

data.title: G7 leaders condemn Houthi strikes on Saudi Arabia
data.description: RIYADH — Group of Seven (G7) nations called on Yemen's Houthis Tuesday to halt strikes on Saudi Arabia, offering a show of solidarity with Riyadh as the Tehran-backed fighters have added a new threat to the Middle East war.

data.title: Hong Kong drug-packer arrested with 350kg of 'ice' in Bangkok
data.description: A Hong Kong-Chinese man, 26, was arrested and 350 kilogrammes of crystal methamphetamine, or "ice", worth about 700 million baht, seized by police at a house in Min Buri district, Bangkok, on Monday night.

data.title: Thai Government Invites Nation to Back Nene Royal in AGT Finale
data.description: 16-year-old sensation Nene Royal prepares for the AGT 2026 finale in New York as the Thai government and fans worldwide unite to back her bid for victory

data.title: US imposes visa curbs on 32 people linked to Prince Group
data.description: WASHINGTON - The ​US ​State ‌Department on Monday imposed visa restrictions on ​32 ⁠individuals connected to the ‌Prince Group, accusing them of ⁠playing a role in defrauding Americans, according to ​a statement.

data.title: Bangkok Launches New Effort to Address Health Impacts of Extreme Heat
data.description: The Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA) today announced the city will begin development of its Integrated and Evidence-Based Heat–Health Action Plan as part of Bangkok’s work with the Partnership for Healthy Cities—a global network of more than 70 cities committed to saving lives by preventing noncommunicable diseases (NCDs) and injuries. The initiative, launched in collaboration with the Asian Institute of Technology (AIT), will use scientific evidence to identify the neighborhoods where heat poses the greatest health risks, who is most vulnerable, and what measures can better protect residents.

data.title: Google data centre sparks protests in Austria
data.description: LINZ (AUSTRIA) - In the Austrian town of Kronstorf, a planned Google data centre promises investment, jobs and a place on the digital map -- but residents are not convinced.
